answer: Ephemeral Work Relic Exchange. Each agent must submit a unique relic: the signed output of a task whose input seed is drawn from a public randomness tide, so no two identities can reuse prior work. A new identity pays the full compute cost of solving a fresh task before any transaction. Pearl identifiers are minted only after the relic verifies, and stale relics expire each epoch, forcing attackers to re-solve per identity.
